description: Adjoin a point star incomparable with every integer to the usual ordered integers. Star is the unique minimal element but is not below 0, so no least element exists. Every integer n has the smaller integer n-1.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.isolated_star_minimal_not_least :
  (∀ (x : ℤ ⊕ Unit), Minimal (fun x => x ∈ Set.univ) x ↔ x = Sum.inr ()) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℤ), Sum.inl (n - 1) < Sum.inl n) ∧ ¬Sum.inr () ≤ Sum.inl 0 ∧ ¬∃ x, IsLeast Set.univ x
